claims.claim_ar: التضاد والتوازي بين إثبات الخلودِ في الآخرة (هُمْ فِيها خالِدُونَ) وبين نفي التخفيف أو التأجيل يُشكّل مقابلة بلاغية تكثّف الحكم وتُعزّز حتمية العقاب.
claims.claim_en: The contrast/parallelism between the affirmation of eternal dwelling ('they will abide therein') and the negation of mitigation/reprieve constitutes a muqabalah (pairing/contrast) that intensifies the ruling and reinforces the inevitability of punishment.
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided chunk explicitly contains 'هُمْ فِيها خالِدُونَ' but does not quote the adjacent negative clauses from the ayah; the assertion of a paired contrast therefore requires connecting that phrase to the other (unquoted) clauses of the verse and should be reviewed against full commentary or text.

claims.claim_ar: كلمة «خالِدون» تؤكّد البقاء الأبدي في الموضع المشار إليه (النار) وتعمل دليلاً لغوياً يستبعد إمكان التخفيف أو التأجيل على من وُصفوا بها.
claims.claim_en: The word 'خالِدون' (abiding) emphasizes eternal permanence in the described place (the Fire) and serves linguistically to exclude the possibility of mitigation or reprieve for those so described.

warnings: The available source chunks include the phrase 'هُمْ فِيها خالِدُونَ' (AL:CHUNK:efe3eff34abc5edc6123081a) but do not include the full adjacent negative clauses ('لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابُ' / 'وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ') as exact substrings. Assertions about parallelism with those negatives therefore involve an inference from the verse context and should be cross-checked against chunks or commentaries that explicitly quote those clauses.
